title: CBSA: paying duty and/or taxes on goods imported by mail or courier
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. Unless specifically exempted, the 5% GST applies to goods imported by mail; CBSA calculates duties on the value in Canadian funds, and duty rates vary by type of goods and their origin. Participating provinces collect HST instead of GST, and PST rates vary by province. Exemptions listed include goods worth CAN$20 or less and gifts worth CAN$60 or less.
